name: ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1
statusNote: ecom lists it as discontinued. Security patches ended in Q3 2025; hardware service runs to Q4 2027.
summary: The ecom Tab-Ex 03 DZ1 is a flameproof (Ex d) 8-inch Android tablet from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX, IECEx and UKEX. It runs Android 13. It has been discontinued; the ecom Tab-Ex 05 DZ1 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex db ia IIC T6 Gb IP64 / II 2D Ex tb ia IIIC T80°C Db
atex.status: IECEx Current (issue 1), checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued (ecom archive).

iecex.marking: Ex db ia IIC T6 Gb IP64 / Ex tb ia IIIC T80°C Db

certification.northAmerica: ETL: Class I, Division 1, Groups A,B,C,D T6; Class II, Division 1, Groups E,F,G T85°C; Class III T85°C; Class I, Zone 1, AEx db ia IIC T6 Gb; Zone 21, Group IIIC T85°C; Ta −20 °C to +50 °C
certification.protection: Flameproof enclosure (Ex db) with an intrinsically safe circuit (Ex ia)

safety.conditions: Flameproof joints not to be repaired; protect against high-energy impacts and high electrostatic charge; ambient −20 °C to +55 °C; USB-C entity parameters Uo 5.6 V, Io 500 mA (IECEx EPS 22.0014X).
safety.peripherals: SIM and microSD are reachable only in non-hazardous areas (flameproof cover). The USB-C port is intrinsically safe and may be used for wired data connections in the hazardous area within its entity parameters (Uo 5.6 V, Io 500 mA, Po 600 mW, Co 1 µF, Lo 1 µH); charging via USB-C only in non-hazardous areas. The S Pen is intrinsically safe and may be used in the hazardous area.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Named in the certificate: Samsung S Pen, ecom type ST T03 X2. No other accessory is named in IECEx EPS 22.0014X.

specs.chip: Samsung Exynos 9810 octa-core (4 x 2.7 GHz + 4 x 1.7 GHz)
specs.touch: Can be operated while wearing gloves
